purpose: Place art outside the kit meshes (#10044): the hanging moss and ivy cards PlaceMossCards grows on the places' lips and wall feet where the surface moss is thick.

moss-cards.generator: local Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image on the owner's RTX 5090 (asset-pipeline tools/texture-edit/qwen_edit.py --size 1024x1024)
moss-cards.assembly: python3 scripts/make-grass-atlas.py content/game/textures/places/moss-cards.png <hang-s71 flipped> <hang-s71 flipped and mirrored> <foot-s71> <foot-s72> --cell 128 --key magenta --ramps foliage,sage,meadow (curtains flipped so their attached edge is the cell's base; hang-s72 was dropped for a painted rod along its top)

cells.prompt: a curtain of hanging moss and small-leaved ivy draping down from a straight horizontal line along the top edge of the image, ragged uneven strands of different lengths, olive green and dark green with a few yellow-green leaves, flat side view, hand-painted game texture sprite in the style of Valheim and 2000s games, broad painterly brush strokes, chunky readable leaf shapes, soft shading, isolated on a pure flat magenta background, no wall, no stone, no shadow, no text, fills the frame width
